result.paraphrase: Artificial intelligence and robotics are very new technologies that pose risks to our world. Their capabilities are growing rapidly, and their original development goals are shifting into other dimensions. By looking at the past histories of AI and robotics, people can examine and understand their aims and intentions, which are to make life easier and support human beings in different circumstances and situations. However, now and in the near future, because of changes in the attitudes of robotic and AI inventors and experts, and because of AI’s nature of environmental acquisition and adaptation, they may become predators and endanger living beings. They may also inherit the full nature of creatures. Ultimately, they will create their own new universe, or the fate of our universe will be at risk.
